# Bundled libraries

Keep these files with the website when copying, submitting or hosting it:

- `bootstrap.min.css`: Bootstrap 5.3.8 styles.
- `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`: Bootstrap 5.3.8 JavaScript bundle, including Popper, for navigation and carousel controls.
- `jquery-4.0.0.min.js`: jQuery 4.0.0 for search and shared interface effects.

The account and profile pages use Bootstrap and plain JavaScript. Other pages load jQuery directly from this folder. Exchange rates still need an internet connection unless previously cached.

These libraries retain their original license notices in the file headers. Bootstrap is distributed under the MIT license; jQuery licensing is described at <https://jquery.com/license/>. Application source and run instructions are documented in the project-level `README.md`.
